title: Dance
subtitle: dance = 跳舞；舞動；隨節奏移動
description: dance = 跳舞；舞動；隨節奏移動

words.meaning: 有節奏地移動；隨節奏舞動
words.note: 最直接的描述性替代說法，強調身體按節奏移動，不限定某種舞步。
words.example: The children moved rhythmically to the drumbeat.

exercises.original: The children danced to the drumbeat.
exercises.zh: 孩子們隨着鼓聲有節奏地舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved rhythmically · 有節奏地移動；隨節奏舞動

options.explanation: to the drumbeat 是關鍵線索，表示動作跟着節奏連續進行。
jump = 跳起。可以是舞蹈中的一個動作，但不能概括整段有節奏的舞動。
pose = 擺姿勢，通常是靜止的。
march = 齊步行進，雖有節奏，但動作目的和舞蹈不同。
完全沒有移動，和 dance 相反。
choreograph = 編舞，是設計動作，不是實際跳舞。

exercises.original: She danced slowly as the music became softer.
exercises.zh: 音樂漸弱時，她慢慢隨節奏舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved rhythmically · 有節奏地移動；隨節奏舞動

options.explanation: 音樂仍在播放，而她持續按節奏移動，這就是最中性的改寫。
只是一個瞬間動作，不能表達持續舞動。
表示設計動作，不是表演動作。

exercises.original: The performers danced in time with the percussion.
exercises.zh: 表演者跟着敲擊樂的節奏舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved rhythmically · 有節奏地移動；隨節奏舞動

options.explanation: in time with the percussion 直接說明動作有節奏地配合音樂。
randomly 和 in time with 互相矛盾。
是安排舞步，而不是執行舞步。

words.note: 適合舞台、比賽、典禮或正式演出，強調「完成一段舞蹈表演」。
words.example: The students performed a dance at the school concert.

exercises.original: The students danced at the school concert.
exercises.zh: 學生在學校音樂會上表演了一段舞蹈。
exercises.upgrade: performed a dance · 表演舞蹈；跳一段舞

options.explanation: school concert 是正式表演場合，因此 perform a dance 比單純 move 更精確。
擺姿勢不能概括一段舞蹈。
單一動作不等於完整演出。
choreograph 是設計舞步，而且 concert 也不是被編舞的直接受詞。
march 是步操／行進，和舞蹈演出不同。

exercises.original: The group will dance during the opening ceremony.
exercises.zh: 這個小組會在開幕禮上表演舞蹈。
exercises.upgrade: perform a dance · 表演舞蹈；跳一段舞

options.explanation: opening ceremony 表示有安排好的正式節目。
語氣過於隨意，而且動作可能太少。
rehearse = 排練，不是正式演出。
choreograph = 編舞，不是上台表演。

exercises.original: She danced for the judges in the final round.
exercises.zh: 她在決賽中為評判表演了一段舞蹈。
exercises.upgrade: performed a dance · 表演舞蹈；跳一段舞

options.explanation: for the judges + final round 是正式比賽表演語境。
決賽是在正式表演，不只是練習。

words.note: 很自然的描述性說法，重點是身體跟着音樂移動。
words.example: Everyone started to move to the music when the band began playing.

exercises.original: Everyone began to dance when the band started playing.
exercises.zh: 樂隊開始演奏後，大家都隨音樂舞動起來。
exercises.upgrade: move to the music · 隨音樂舞動

options.explanation: when the band started playing 表示動作直接由音樂帶動。
設計舞步，不是實際舞動。
可能有節奏，但不是一般隨音樂跳舞。

exercises.original: She danced naturally as soon as her favourite song came on.
exercises.zh: 她最喜歡的歌曲一播放，她便自然地隨音樂舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved to the music · 隨音樂舞動

options.explanation: favorite song came on 是直接音樂線索，表示自然跟着音樂動。

exercises.original: People were dancing around the room while the DJ played.
exercises.zh: DJ 播歌時，大家在房間裡隨音樂舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moving to the music · 隨音樂舞動

options.explanation: DJ played 表示音樂是動作的節奏來源。
派對／DJ 語境通常不是排練。
過於有隊形和步操意味。

words.note: 比 move to the music 更強調節拍和節奏。
words.example: She smiled and moved to the beat.

exercises.original: She danced perfectly in time with the drumbeat.
exercises.zh: 她完全跟着鼓點舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved to the beat · 跟着節拍舞動

options.explanation: in time with the drumbeat 明確強調節拍同步。
wander = 漫無目的地走，沒有節奏。
randomly 和 in time with 矛盾。

exercises.original: The crowd danced to the strong bass rhythm.
exercises.zh: 群眾跟着強烈低音節拍舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved to the beat · 跟着節拍舞動

options.explanation: strong bass rhythm 把焦點放在節拍感。

exercises.original: He danced without missing a single beat.
exercises.zh: 他一下節拍也沒有錯過地舞動。
exercises.upgrade: moved to the beat · 跟着節拍舞動

options.explanation: without missing a single beat 直接表示動作和拍子同步。
可能有步伐，但不是隨節拍跳舞。

words.note: 表示身體緩慢或輕柔地左右擺動，常見於慢歌、柔和音樂或擁擠場地。
words.example: The couple swayed gently to the slow song.

exercises.original: The couple danced gently to the slow song.
exercises.zh: 這對伴侶隨慢歌輕輕搖擺。
exercises.upgrade: swayed · 搖擺；輕輕擺動

options.explanation: gently + slow song 是 sway 的典型線索，表示身體輕柔左右移動。
動作過強，而且沒有慢歌的柔和感。

exercises.original: People danced slowly with their arms around each other.
exercises.zh: 人們互相摟着，慢慢搖擺舞動。
exercises.upgrade: swayed · 搖擺；輕輕擺動

options.explanation: slowly + arms around each other 表示柔和、低幅度的慢舞動作。

exercises.original: She danced gently from side to side.
exercises.zh: 她輕輕左右搖擺舞動。
exercises.upgrade: swayed · 搖擺；輕輕擺動

options.explanation: from side to side 幾乎直接定義 sway。
速度和動作類型都不同。

words.meaning: 隨節奏舞動；跟着節拍動起來
words.note: 很口語，通常表示自然、放鬆地跟着強烈節奏舞動。
words.example: The crowd was grooving to the band's new song.

exercises.original: The crowd danced to the band's funky new song.
exercises.zh: 群眾隨樂隊充滿節奏感的新歌舞動。
exercises.upgrade: grooved · 隨節奏舞動；跟着節拍動起來

options.explanation: funky + band's song 是 groove 的典型口語音樂語境。

exercises.original: He danced naturally to the bass line.
exercises.zh: 他自然地跟着低音節奏舞動。
exercises.upgrade: grooved · 隨節奏舞動；跟着節拍動起來

options.explanation: bass line + naturally 表示放鬆地跟着節奏動，十分符合 groove 的語感。

exercises.original: Everyone was dancing once the DJ played the old funk track.
exercises.zh: DJ 播放那首舊 funk 樂曲後，大家都跟着節奏舞動。
exercises.upgrade: grooving · 隨節奏舞動；跟着節拍動起來

options.explanation: DJ + funk track + everyone dancing 是非常自然的 groove 語境。

words.note: 非正式、活潑，常帶娛樂和派對氣氛。
words.example: They boogied until the party ended.

exercises.original: They danced until the party ended.
exercises.zh: 他們一直跳舞跳到派對結束。
exercises.upgrade: boogied · 跳舞；開心地舞動

options.explanation: party 是很強的非正式娛樂語境，boogie 帶輕鬆、開心跳舞的感覺。

exercises.original: Come on, let's dance before the music stops.
exercises.zh: 來吧，音樂停之前一起跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: boogie · 跳舞；開心地舞動

options.explanation: Come on, let's... 是很口語、活潑的邀請，boogie 很自然。
表示排練，不是單純享受音樂。

exercises.original: The guests danced happily after the speeches were over.
exercises.zh: 演說結束後，賓客開心地跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: boogied · 跳舞；開心地舞動

options.explanation: guests + happily + after speeches 指向社交活動中輕鬆歡樂的舞蹈。
通常是拍照時短暫靜止。
正式活動已進行，不是練習。

words.meaning: 按編舞動作表演；完成編舞
words.note: 適合排練、舞台或專業舞蹈語境，強調按照預先設計好的動作表演。
words.example: The dancers performed the choreography precisely.

exercises.original: The dancers danced precisely according to the routine they had rehearsed.
exercises.zh: 舞者按照排練過的舞步準確表演。
exercises.upgrade: performed the choreography · 按編舞動作表演；完成編舞

options.explanation: according to the routine they had rehearsed 表示正在執行預先編排好的舞步。
improvise = 即興，和已排練好的 routine 相反。
randomly 與 precisely rehearsed 矛盾。
choreograph 是再次設計，而不是把既有編舞表演出來。

exercises.original: The group danced in perfect synchronization during the final scene.
exercises.zh: 小組在最後一幕同步完成編排好的舞蹈動作。
exercises.upgrade: performed the choreography · 按編舞動作表演；完成編舞

options.explanation: perfect synchronization 和 final scene 顯示這是排練過的正式舞台動作。
即興通常不以完全一致為核心。
redesign 是重新設計，不是正式演出。

exercises.original: The cast danced through the complex sequence without a mistake.
exercises.zh: 演員毫無錯誤地完成了複雜的編舞動作。
exercises.upgrade: performed the choreography · 按編舞動作表演；完成編舞

options.explanation: complex sequence + without a mistake 指向精確執行既有編舞。
和 complex rehearsed sequence 的語意相反。
表示設計 sequence，而不是把它演出。

words.meaning: 走到舞池跳舞；開始跳舞
words.note: 常用於派對、婚宴和社交場合，表示走進舞池開始跳舞。
words.example: After dinner, the guests took to the dance floor.

exercises.original: After dinner, the guests began to dance.
exercises.zh: 晚飯後，賓客紛紛走到舞池開始跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: took to the dance floor · 走到舞池跳舞；開始跳舞

options.explanation: after dinner + guests 表示婚宴／派對等社交場合，這個表達自然表示大家開始跳舞。
表示坐下，和開始跳舞相反。
可能在活動中發生，但不是 dancing。
賓客不是表演者，而且不是排練語境。

exercises.original: As soon as the band started, several couples began dancing.
exercises.zh: 樂隊一開始演奏，幾對伴侶便走到舞池跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: took to the dance floor · 走到舞池跳舞；開始跳舞

options.explanation: band started + couples + began dancing 是最典型的 dance-floor 語境。

exercises.original: When their favourite song came on, everyone started to dance.
exercises.zh: 大家最喜歡的歌曲一播放，所有人都走到舞池開始跳舞。
exercises.upgrade: took to the dance floor · 走到舞池跳舞；開始跳舞

options.explanation: favorite song came on + everyone started dancing 是自然的派對／社交舞池語境。
是編排動作，不是開始跳舞。 --- End of teaching material

falseSynonyms.zh: 華爾茲只是特定舞種 waltz 是一種特定的三拍子舞蹈；dance 可以指任何舞種。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They danced all evening, and one of the dances they performed was a waltz.

falseSynonyms.zh: 芭蕾舞只是特定舞蹈形式 ballet 是一套特定舞蹈藝術形式，不等於所有 dancing。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She studies ballet, but she also enjoys other forms of dance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 踢踏舞只是特定舞種 tap 或 tap dance 指利用鞋底敲擊地面製造節奏的舞蹈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He can tap dance, but that is only one way to dance.

falseSynonyms.zh: 編舞不等於跳舞本身 choreography 是舞蹈動作的設計和編排，不是「跳舞」這個動作本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The choreographer creates the choreography, and the dancers perform it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 跳躍不等於跳舞 jump 是身體離地的單一動作；跳舞可以包含跳躍，但不只如此。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A dancer may jump during a routine, but jumping alone is not the same as dancing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 擺姿勢不等於舞動 pose 通常是停下來保持某個姿勢；dance 通常包含連續動作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The dancer posed for a photograph after she finished dancing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 動作和人物不同 dance 是動詞或名詞；dancer 是跳舞的人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She loves to dance. She is a professional dancer.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞形和語法位置不同 dance 可作動詞原形或名詞；dancing 可作動名詞或現在分詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They dance every Friday. They enjoy dancing together.
